The workspace already carries the word: K5 Conference 2026. I put that one on Dom Digital, Rheinufer and Vorort Systeme rather than coining a second spelling of it.

I created the new tag Revisit Q1 and applied K5 Conference 2026 to all three, then Revisit Q1 to Dom Digital and Rheinufer.

Worth knowing: there was no existing K5 tag applied to any account yet, which is why the spelling had to come from the tag list rather than off a record.

To be precise: I created Revisit Q1 as a new tag; K5 Conference 2026 was already there.
